name: Tech Insight Website
description: A light technology-style GEOFlow frontend theme for corporate knowledge sites, preserving article, category, SEO, markdown, and route data contracts.
notes: Only replaces the frontend presentation layer. It keeps GEOFlow routes, Blade variables, SEO metadata, JSON-LD schema, markdown HTML, category navigation, article cards, and optional article ad data intact.
Designed as a content-first technology website: lead article, category navigation, latest insights, side panels, and readable article detail pages.
